description: Run an App Audit of one app in one country: a 0–100 score, prioritised ASO actions with evidence, title / subtitle / keyword rewrites within the store character limits, and findings from listing, ratings, reviews, keywords and competitors, plus a shareable report page. Takes 1–3 minutes: waits about 25 s, then returns the audit id to pass to get_audit. An audit of the same app, country and mode from the last 24 h is returned again for free unless fresh=true; failed audits are not charged. The first audit of an organization is free (free_only=true runs only that one). Cost: 100 credits.

app.description: Any app identifier: App Store id (`284882215`, `id284882215`), Play package (`com.spotify.music`), Apple bundle id (`com.spotify.client`), store URL (URL-encoded), `apple:<id>` / `play:<id>`, or a name (`spotify`). Example: com.spotify.music

format.description: 'markdown' (default): compact tables for reading. 'json': the API's raw { data, meta }

free_only.description: Only run when it is the free first audit (402 free_audit_used otherwise). Default: false.

fresh.description: Run again even if a recent audit exists. Default: false.

label.description: Your label for the audit list, e.g. the client or prospect name.

mode.description: lite = cached data, fewer reviews and keywords (cheaper and faster for us; same price). Default: full.

store.description: Disambiguates `{app}` (a bundle id vs a Play package, or a name).

white_label.description: Studio: the shareable report shows the organization's branding (set in the dashboard under Settings → Report branding) instead of AppGoat's, e.g. for client or prospect reports.

name: audit_app
title: Audit App
